cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(ctxpp_fixture LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
add_library(plan src/plan.cpp src/other.cpp)
target_include_directories(plan PUBLIC include)
target_compile_definitions(plan PRIVATE CTXPP_FAST=1)
target_compile_options(plan PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
add_executable(plan_test tests/test_plan.cpp)
target_link_libraries(plan_test PRIVATE plan)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME plan_test COMMAND plan_test)
